summary: Review C (UX and API end-to-end contract) of Phase 1 'Council fixes' at audited HEAD a6d696902a0f98064e8cab3624afa1def4a72cbe; HEAD was current at start and at end (no move observed). The Review C row of test-strategy P1.6 applies (yes, required), so the audit ran against the phase diff 4154e0ff2..a6d696902 of apps/storytime and packages/read-along. Verdict: pass, no blocking findings, four non-blocking findings. Every Review C item checks out: the child-facing labels ('Read the words', 'Playing', Thai drafts), the aria-pressed plus playing-label design (spec AC-1.6 pins both), the page count '1 / N' with aria-live between the arrows, the 48 px targets (Next, the 404 link, the buttons), the Thai 404 and playing drafts (each key holds a value in both message files and the equal-value rules hold), the pinned exports highestOpenWeeks, parseStorytimePath, and highlightWindows/MIN_WORD_WINDOW_S (0.12 s, borrowed time pushes the next word later), the tap affordance rule (a no-clip word has no tabindex, no cursor-pointer, and no tap; a clip word keeps all three in My turn), the audio error text for a failing clip (role=alert, locale-correct text, no stuck state), the Workbooks contract names wordClips (key allowlist, mediaPath values, default {}) and videoLeadInSeconds (0-30, default 0, video-only subtraction), and the accepted Q22 residual (the song lyric lines still update on timeupdate, up to 250 ms late). Green's user-facing defaults match the plan: Next is disabled only at the last page when the reader has no tiles and no questions, only Next holds the page (Previous and a swipe turn at once), and the 404 client view shows the Thai line on the Thai locale because the values are equal in both message files. The short-word hit area under 44 px is the documented trade-off of plan 1.8 and goes to the browser review with a note.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] reader word hit area under 44 px for short words. The hit area of a word is a pseudo-element extended 0.25 rem on each side and 0.5 rem above and below (packages/read-along/components/read-along/read-along-passage.tsx, HIT_AREA_CLASSES). A short word such as 'I' keeps a hit area narrower than 44 px (about 13 px wide). This is the documented trade-off of plan 1.8 (a full 44 px box would take the tap of its neighbour, and the old min-w-[44px] layout box caused the council finding 18 gap). Rationale: no shipped rule states a floor for this phase beyond reachability, and the plan note accepts the narrow area. Action: the browser review should confirm that 'I' on pages 1 and 4 stays reachable and that the neighbour word does not steal its tap.

F2 [Major] the tap affordance of clip words is pointer-only. In My turn a word with a clip gets cursor-pointer, a hover tint, and a focus ring; a word with no clip gets none. On a touch device a child sees no difference before a tap, so when some words have no clip (the shipped w01 has 6 of 12 reader words without a clip) a child cannot see which words answer. Rationale: the strategy pins only the DOM rule (Q17), which Green met, and the tapped-word mark during a clip is not asserted (Q19). Action: propose a visual marker (for example an underline) at Daniel's look check of 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-18.

F3 [Minor] the song lyric lines still light on the timeupdate event, so a line can show up to about 250 ms late (Q22 residual). The lead-in subtraction removes the 3.0 s error only. Rationale: Q22 accepts the lag and the plan asks for the offset only. Action: none in this phase; record the lag as a known limit in the at-home release evidence if a child notices it.

F4 [Minor] out-of-scope paths touched by the track. phase3-decodable-punct.test.tsx and phase3-loops-off.test.tsx were edited by Green with reasons in the commit bodies (expected, named in the Green log), and the www Storytime page copy changed in the docs commit a776187e2 (a strategy amendment, outside the Phase 1 allowed path list of closeout item 3). Rationale: none of these touches the child-facing contract of the phase. Action: the acceptance role counts them in look_out_of_scope_paths and decides.
evidence: messages check (python json load): tileDecodable en='Read the words' th='อ่านคำ'; playerPlaying en='Playing' th='กำลังเล่น'; notOpenThai, notOpenEnglish, openWeekThai, openWeekEnglish, notFoundThai, notFoundEnglish hold equal values in messages/en.json and messages/th.json; key parity holds (no en-only or th-only key). The four 404 values match the spec text exactly, including 'เปิดสัปดาห์ {week}' with the {week} placeholder.

aria-pressed design: reader.tsx pins the three audio buttons with aria-pressed={pressedMode===mode} and swaps the label to the playing label while pressed (pressedMode = isPlaying || (mode==='myTurn' && clipPlaying)); at most one button presses because one audio element feeds isPlaying. decodable.tsx gives the sound button aria-pressed={soundPlaying} and the same label swap. This matches spec AC-1.6, which pins both the pressed state and the playing label.

page count: reader.tsx renders {pageNumber} / {book.pages.length} in DOM order between the Previous arrow and the Next arrow; the count reads the shown pageIndex+1, so during the Next hold it stays on the old page and never reads 2 / 8 over the page 1 sentence.

48 px targets: the Next button and the audio buttons carry min-h-12 (48 px); the 404 link class holds min-h-12 plus a fill; the look-feedback and look-not-found tests parse min-h tokens with a 48 px floor and reject min-h-11.

pinned exports: lib/content.ts exports highestOpenWeeks() reading levels 1..LEVEL_MAX and weeks 1..WEEK_MAX with loadWeek, applying the same rule as loadVisibleWeek (readinessBlocker plus showDraftMedia for media_not_approved only) with no log lines; lib/route-parse.ts exports parseStorytimePath(pathname, locales) returning { locale, level, week } or null, using parseCanonicalNumber (^[1-9][0-9]*$ with bounds) and writing no log; lib/highlight-windows.ts exports MIN_WORD_WINDOW_S = 0.12 and highlightWindows(words, minSeconds = MIN_WORD_WINDOW_S), where a short word borrows time from the next word (cursor pushes the next start later, never earlier) and a clean list returns unchanged.

tap affordance: reader.tsx passes wordIsTarget=(audioWord) => Object.hasOwn(wordClips, audioWord.toLowerCase()) to ReadAlongPassage; read-along-passage.tsx gives a target word cursor-pointer, tabIndex -1, a keydown handler, and a focus ring only when interactive and a target; a no-clip word has none of these and its onClick is not set, so a click plays nothing (AC-1.12, Q17).

clip error text: onWordTap maps a rejected play or an empty signed URL to setAudioFailed(true), the clip element 'error' event also sets it, and the page shows

with labels.audioError (English) or the pinned Thai text; a later tap clears the state and plays (no stuck state), covering C7 and C9.

Workbooks contract: lib/contracts/week.ts pins bookAudioSchema.wordClips as z.record(wordClipKey, mediaPath).default({}) with key rule ^[a-z]+(['-][a-z]+)*$ at most 40 characters and a refine that rejects inherited property names, and songSchema.videoLeadInSeconds as z.number().min(0).max(30).default(0); scripts/receive-weeks.ts mediaOf lists each clip once with kind 'word-clip'. song.tsx subtracts the lead-in only when a video plays (audio fallback uses 0), so O3 catches a rule that always subtracts.

Green defaults: Next is disabled only when pendingIndex===null, pageIndex is the last page, and hasEnd is false (hasEnd = tiles.length>0 || (questions.length>0 && questionLabels!==undefined)); goToNext holds only the Next press (pendingIndex plus a hidden eager img with a 3000 ms cap and an error path), while Previous and the swipe handler call goToPage and turn at once.

Thai 404 view: app/[locale]/not-found.tsx stays a server component with no props, calls highestOpenWeeks(), and renders the client NotFoundView (export NotFoundView, props openWeeks and locale); the child imports messages from en.json, which is safe because the values are equal in both message files, and it renders the Thai heading with lang='th' on every locale, so the Thai 404 shows Thai.
app icon: xxd of apps/storytime/app/icon.png shows the 8-byte PNG signature, IHDR, 128 x 128 (0x80), 10215 bytes, and a trailing IEND chunk, meeting AC-1.8.

song first frame: song.tsx holds the stage inline background-image with the poster until the onPlaying event sets framePlayed, keeps playsInline, changes preload to 'metadata' (Q14 accepted), and clears the video background to transparent only before a frame plays (Q13 left to Green).

Green gate evidence (measure/runs/storytime_look_20261107/green-p1-a620b096f.log round 2 at 51ef687ec): final targeted command exit 0, files=70, tests_passed=535, tests_failed=0, tests_skipped=0 (R-COUNT 478-8+65=535 matches); tsc exit 0 with look_tsc_errors=0; ESLint exit 0 (one warning left by Red); packages/read-along 104/104; detectors wordCutBounds/cutEnd/seekAndRun/stopAtMediaEnd in reader.tsx exit 1, wordClips and videoLeadInSeconds present, use-read-along imported by reader.tsx.
